infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: NEXA uses the camera when you capture photos or documents for knowledge and chat attachments.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: NEXA uses the microphone when you record voice notes or speak to your AI assistant.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: NEXA reads and writes calendar events only when you connect calendar features or ask your assistant to schedule.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: NEXA accesses contacts only when you explicitly share or look up people for messaging and scheduling.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: NEXA sends notifications for task reminders, automation approvals, and assistant alerts you opt into.
